title: Ndzhwalo Wa Nyiko Leyi Aleke
intro: Eku sunguleni ka matimu ya vanhu, loko misava ya ha ri yitsongo naswona misava yi khome moya wo sungula, moya-xiviri wu yime emahlweni ka Muvumbi wu ri ni gandzelo ro titsongahata. Gandzelo rero ri pimiwe hi ku ringanisela ka ku amukeriwa hi Xikwembu — naswona ri kumiwile ri kayivela. Leswi landzeleke a ku nga ri xitori xa ku rivalela, kambe xa mbilu leyi dyiweke hi mavondzo, leyi yisaka eka xiendlo lexi nga hundzukiki lexi a xi ta twala hi nkarhi hinkwawo. Lexi i xitori xa un’wana loyi vito rakwe ri veke leri fanaka ni ku pfumaleka ka vululami ko sungula lokukulu loku tshameke ku endliwa.
clues: Ndzi ve kona tanihi un’wana wa vana vo sungula swinene lava tshameke va velekiwa, ndzi velekiwile hi mutswari loyi xitori xa yena u xi tivaka kahle.
Ndzi tshame ndzi nyikela gandzelo eka Allah, kambe a ri amukeriwanga eka mina — hambi leswi gandzelo ra makwerhu wa mina ri amukeriweke hi tintswalo.
Mavondzo ni vukarhi swi dzime timitsu embilwini ya mina, kutani ndzi xungeta ku herisa vutomi bya maxaka ya mina.
Makwerhu wa mina u ndzi tsundzuxe leswaku ndzi chava Allah, kambe ku tikukumuxa ka mina a ku ndzi pfumelelanga ku yingisela.
Hi nkarhinyana wa ku tsana loku chavisaka, ndzi endle xiendlo lexi nga hlamuselekiki eka makwerhu wa mina n’wini.
Endzhaku ka sweswo, a ndzi nga swi tivi hambi ku ri ku fihla leswi ndzi swi endleke — ku kondza ku rhumeriwa xivumbiwa xa misava leswaku xi ta ndzi dyondzisa.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku nyikela gandzelo leri a ri ariwile, leri yiseke eku dlayeni ko sungula
Ku aka xihondzo lexi tlakukeke leswaku u ta fika ematilweni
Ku hoxiwa endzilweni lowu pfurhaka hikwalaho ka ripfumelo ra munhu
Ku nyikela hi n’wana wa wena hi ku yingisa Allah

trial.answer: Ku nyikela gandzelo leri a ri ariwile, leri yiseke eku dlayeni ko sungula

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ku ve ka lava tisolaka, va tikeriwa hi vugevenga byo sungula lebyi tshameke byi endliwa
U rivaleriwile hi Allah naswona u nyikiwe Paradeyisi leyi nga heriki
U tlakuseriwe exitichini lexi tlakukeke xa vuprofeta ni vutlhari
U ponisiwile hi tintswalo ta Xikwembu endzhaku ko huwelela a ri evuentweni bya munyama
U nyikiwe vulawuri ehenhla ka jinn, moya ni malwandle
outcome.answer: Ku ve ka lava tisolaka, va tikeriwa hi vugevenga byo sungula lebyi tshameke byi endliwa

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
